resource: Value lines of one bank operation (BANK-0 §5, §8)
allocation_impact: 1 CONVERSION value line for a deposit or withdrawal, 2 TRANSFER value lines for a transfer; checked in the payload gate. DUR03-RL-03 stays 0 for every existing shape.
boundary_tests: a transfer carries exactly 2 value lines
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/bank.rs (bank writer: checked before any ledger entry, coin line, balance change or event; a typed refusal or error writes no value)
notes: BANK-0 §8 (owner answers 1b and Q1 b; ARCH-BATCH-ROOT-PACKETS-V1 §1.8 and §2.4); registered by BANK-1 before the code that relies on it.
